property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that accepts calls, C.transfer(...) always returns true when it completes (non-reverting); the mutant returns false after successful completion, violating this return-value property for some inputs.

For any non-empty _tos and any callee that does not revert, C.transfer(...) returns true when the call completes; the mutant returns false after successful completion, so there exist inputs (non-empty _tos and a non-reverting callee) where the return value differs.

For every admissible input where transfer(...) completes (does not revert), the reference implementation always returns true; the mutant returns false (breaks the rule) for any input that completes successfully.

For every call to C.transfer that completes (does not revert), the reference returns true; the mutant returns false, so the property is that successful calls return true (assert that invoking transfer yields a boolean true), which the mutant violates for any successful invocation.
